# CA Ashish Pandla — Complete Professional Profile & Executive Context

## Executive Profile

Ashish Pandla is a Senior Finance Leader and Chartered Accountant (CA) based in India with over 8 years of distinguished experience spanning Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Financial Controlling, Accounting Operations, Ind-AS / IFRS Compliance, and Strategic Business Partnering. He has driven multi-crore cost transformations, high-velocity unicorn financial operations, capital buybacks, and global corporate entity structuring across CARS24 and cargo-partner.

## Key Career Projects & Achievements

### ₹50 Lakhs Annual Cost Optimization
Led enterprise-wide cost-control initiatives across CARS24 operational hubs and cost centers. Analyzed operational leakages and implemented targeted vendor re-negotiations and process efficiencies that yielded recurring ₹50 lakhs in annual bottom-line savings.

### Profitability Turnaround of ~75% Profit Centers
Led commercial and operational finance turnaround of operational units. Designed diagnostic unit-level profitability models that restored ~75% of previously loss-making centers to profitability, elevated productivity by 20%, and doubled ROI from 1x to 2x.

### ₹80 Crore ESOP Share Buyback
Orchestrated end-to-end financial operations, regulatory clearances, capital allocation, and valuation reconciliation for an ₹80 Crore employee stock ownership plan (ESOP) buyback at CARS24.

### Big-4 Audit Clean Opinion & ICFR Excellence
Spearheaded statutory, internal, tax, and ICFR audits with Ernst & Young (EY) and Grant Thornton. Closed all complex legacy audit points and secured the company’s first clean Internal Audit & ICFR reports with zero major qualifications.

### International Entity Structuring & Refurbishment Facilities (MRL)
Established international banking relationships, corporate structuring, and tax compliance frameworks for overseas corporate entities. Structured end-to-end accounting mechanisms for CARS24 Mega Refurbishment Labs (MRL), encompassing spare parts inventory controls, refurbishment labor costing, and warranty service revenue recognition.
